schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The librarian: owner of the graph trees — db_domain's first real tenant — owner of the EMBED SEAM every tree-writing device composes, and, when its face is whole, a chatbot that is learning always and summarizing when asked. THE EMBED SEAM'S CONTRACT (live.py: embed_via_domain returns the vector alone; embed_metered_via_domain, added 2026-07-29 for ticket a-node-holds-one-claim, returns {vector, tokens} where tokens is the host's own prompt_eval_count and is None on a cache HIT — not-reported is not zero, and inventing a number there would be a proxy metric wearing a measurement's clothes; the vector-only contract is deliberately untouched beside it). v0 is the SPINE (trees.py): a provenance-gated deposit door (a node is content + vector + provenance + standing; the untraceable never lands; every node is born a hypothesis) and proximity walks whose edges are DERIVED from the vectors at walk time, never stored — 'the embedding IS the path through the graph trees.' v0.1 adds THE CORE LOOP (loop.py): always the graph first; when the walk's best cosine misses RESOLUTION_FLOOR, the LLM is asked for NODES (never the answer), they deposit through the same provenance gate, and the ORIGINAL question resubmits — the proof the backfill worked is that structure now resolves it. The backfill-cache livelock is fixed as physics at that junction: the prompt carries tree_state's digest (same question + changed graph = different cache key) and a round depositing nothing fresh terminates loudly as no_progress. v0.2 adds THE LIBRARY + THE LEARN VERB (library.py): a room in instance-space at the ratified address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/ — a shelf of FROZEN copies with stable citable addresses (the register freezes each file's digest; re-shelving same content writes nothing; different content at a standing address is refused — an address must not rot, because provenance anchors point INTO it). The graph is the catalog, not the shelf: LEARN is deposit-only — every passage of a shelved file embeds and deposits through the same provenance gate, anchored {source: library:<address>, passage: p<n>, sha256}, cited by RAW paragraph position so filtering never renumbers. v0.3 adds THE SUMMARIZE VERB (summarize.py): the transducer across the storage axis — a dense region of the graph (the k nearest SOURCE nodes around the question) rendered by the drafting model into articulated, why-carrying prose. The physics: a summary is a VIEW over the graph, never a document the graph forgets — citations are CODE-BUILT from the walked region (the model only marks [n]; an unanchored or minted citation refuses loudly, raw carried whole); the rendered prose DEPOSITS BACK into the same tree, provenance naming the exact nodes it rendered + the region's digest, so follow-ups are walks; the transducer never eats its own output (gather excludes summary-sourced nodes), which makes the verb idempotent — the region rides the render prompt whole, so same question + same source region is a cached render and a duplicate deposit. Depth travels with the artifact (region reached vs tree size). v0.4 adds THE CHAT FACE (chat.py + shim.py): the conversational surface over the loop and the transducer, adding NO third mechanism — LEARNING ALWAYS is every turn crossing the core loop (the reply is the graph's walk, never the generate text; the transcript is runtime state, the graph is the memory that survives the session); SUMMARIZING WHEN ASKED is the `summarize:` prefix routing to the transducer — the route is PHYSICS (a stated affordance), never an inference spent guessing intent. A verb's loud refusal becomes a legible reply the session survives. THE CARRIER (corrected 2026-07-28): there is ONE web server in the whole system, and the librarian owns a PAGE it displays — the chat window is a surface the base shim class understands: the device DECLARES the chat pane, LibrarianShim rides the roster and STARTS THE DEVICE IF IT IS NOT RUNNING (attaching the live face at the wake), and a POSTed utterance travels web_server → shim.deliver → device.receive as ordinary mail. No chat route, no port, no second door. Live wiring: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query|loop|shelve|learn|summarize]` and `python3 cairn/web_server/listener.py` for the conversation at /device/librarian (all verbs through inference_domain, metered and cached; trees.py, loop.py, library.py, summarize.py and chat.py are import-pure toward host+DB and the proofs pin it — live composition lives in live.py and the shim's wake).
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The core loop he named 'very simple' (2026-07-22): a query resolves by traversing the trees — cheap, no inference; on a MISS the LLM supplies the NODES that let the graph resolve, never the answer; the answer always comes from structure, so re-asking is a graph walk. That is Law 1 as a runtime mechanism, and this store is the structure it runs on. The deposit door's provenance gate is the extractor's founding defect carried one layer down: a fabricated attribution in a draft is a bad day; in a graph node it is a permanent resident.
invoke: import: `from cairn.librarian.trees import LibrarianDevice, deposit, nearest, neighbors`, `from cairn.librarian.loop import resolve_query`, `from cairn.librarian.library import shelve, learn, shelf_entry, passages`, `from cairn.librarian.summarize import summarize, gather`, `from cairn.librarian.chat import ChatSession, chat_turn`. Prove: the five scripts under cairn/librarian/proofs/ + cairn/web_server/proofs/test_web_server_chat.py for the carried page (exit 0 = green; need the one-time DB provisioning, no host). Live: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query]` (founding demo), `... loop [question] [tree]` (the core loop; dual seam — nomic-embed-text embeds, qwen2.5:7b drafts, model stamped on each request so it rides the cache key), `... shelve` (acquire the founding collection), `... learn <address> [tree]` (fold one shelved file in), `... summarize <tree> "question"` (the transducer, live). Chat: `python3 cairn/web_server/listener.py` then http://127.0.0.1/device/librarian — the shim wakes the device and attaches the face over the library tree, both verbs through the one door.
node_class: device — owner of the graph trees; fires per deposit/walk request, never on a clock. The library room (instance-space, RATIFIED address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/) is its shelf space — a later stone, not this one.
entry: FRESH build. UU had a graph-tree embeddings generator that self-trained via API calls — a graft candidate deliberately NOT carried into v0 (its mechanism may cross later the way isolation.py did; design re-authored). What v0 reuses is Cairn's own: db_domain's owner-gate as the write physics, inference_domain's embed seam as the vector source, the extractor's judged-at-the-door discipline.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split.
how_it_learns: Three loops, staged. (1) BUILT NOW, the substrate: every deposit is a learned fact taking structural residence — the graph IS the memory, and a duplicate deposit writing nothing is Law 1 at the door. The LEARN verb (library.py, built 2026-07-27) is this loop's bulk intake: a shelved file folded in passage by passage, deposit-only, every node citing shelf + passage + frozen digest. (2) FILED, the tenure loop: every node is born standing='hypothesis' (Law 3) and today honestly STAYS there — tenure (does the node keep resolving well?) becomes a measurement when the core loop runs and outcomes accumulate; if nodes still all read 'hypothesis' weeks into live use, that loop never landed and standing is a decoration (the falsifier says so). (3) BUILT NOW, the core loop itself (loop.py): on a MISS the LLM provides nodes, the graph folds them in and the ORIGINAL question re-resolves — learning always, as the face's standing behavior; measured live 2026-07-27 (first crossing: one backfill, one fresh node, then RESOLVED at 0.8568; second crossing: zero backfills, zero inference in the answer path). The SUMMARIZE verb closes a fourth, reflexive loop (built 2026-07-27): the graph keeps its own distillations — every summary deposits back as structure, so what the librarian articulates it also remembers, and a follow-up walks to it instead of re-rendering. The librarian is the component whose learning IS its function; 'it doesn't learn' would be a charter violation here, not a valid answer.
filed_edges: (a) RESOLUTION_FLOOR = 0.65 IS AN n=1 GUESS (seeded by the first live walk: right node 0.7473, adjacent 0.6278), returned in every verdict so no caller mistakes it for settled; it tunes against real use. (The loop itself is BUILT — this edge narrowed from 'build the loop' to 'earn the floor'.)

(b) A DUPLICATE DROPS ITS NEW PROVENANCE: corroboration (a second source saying the same thing) is evidence the tenure loop will want; when that loop lands, a duplicate becomes a provenance APPEND, not a discard.
(c) THE TENURE LOOP (standing: hypothesis -> earned) — unbuilt; see how_it_learns (2).

(d) PROXIMITY IS COMPUTED IN PYTHON, O(n) PER WALK — correct now, and every deposit re-reads the tree for its dimension check; pgvector (proximity computed where the vectors live) when a real load pulls it.
(e) TREES-INDEX-INTO-COMMONS GRANTS (private-down default, grant-up explicit) — one table with a tree column today; the grant model opens when a second owner exists.

(f) THE DESK — 'a workspace/desk for current work': the assignment's home (topic, folded-so-far, open threads, resume-event) lands as files in a `_desk` register; underscore names are already reserved for it. Unbuilt until the multi-day research face needs it.

(g) NARROWED 2026-07-27 — THE SUMMARIZER IS BUILT (summarize.py, stone 4); what remains of this edge: SUMMARY_REGION_K = 8 is an n=1 guess (one live transduction at pick time), the region is one nearest-k walk (multi-hop via neighbors() when a real summary proves too narrow), and find-pattern-in-clump / de-instance-for-exchange arrive as CALLERS, not new verbs.

(h) NARROWED 2026-07-27 — THE CHAT SURFACE IS BUILT (chat.py + shim.py, a declared PANE on the librarian's page at the one web server — stone 5, the chain's last; first cast as a bespoke /chat route, corrected 2026-07-28 on Akien's word: surfaces live in the shim, and the shim starts its device): what remains: ONE UTTERANCE IS ONE QUESTION (conversation -> questions decomposition stays the core-loop ticket's edge d, grow against measured need); the transcript is in-process only (a persistent conversation berths in instance-space when a real need pulls it); the route is a stated prefix — if live use shows humans not finding the affordance, the fix is surface wording first, intent inference last.

(i) DIAGRAM-SHAPED PASSAGES RANK POORLY: measured 2026-07-27 — the agent-cycle flow diagram (arrows, numbered steps) scored 0.4943 against a prose question it directly answers, UNDER two less-relevant prose passages. Diagram-ish text may want a prose rendering before embedding (a transducer-shaped fix, not a floor fix).

(j) A MALFORMED BACKFILL DRAFT IS CACHED: qwen2.5:7b emitted invalid JSON once; parse_backfill refused loudly with the raw whole (as designed) — but same question + same graph now HITS that cached draft, so the question cannot backfill until the graph changes. Honest per the key physics; if it bites, a retry rides a CHANGED request (the refusal folded into the prompt = a different key), never a cache bypass.
(k) A BINARY SHELVES BUT REFUSES TO LEARN (not utf-8) — the Readings PDFs need a reader in front of the verb; loud refusal today, not a silent skip.

(l) BACKFILL NODES HAVE A HOME-FIELD ADVANTAGE, measured 2026-07-27: on a follow-up question, three labels minted DURING that crossing outranked both the landed summary (4th, 0.5960) and every shelved passage — backfill nodes are generated FROM the question, so they are born question-shaped and win the similarity race for it; the loop can satisfy its own floor with its own fresh mints. Everything stays traceable (source: llm-backfill, standing: hypothesis), so Laws 3/7 hold — but this is the tenure loop's (edge c) sharpest why yet: question-echo nodes must EARN residence by resolving other questions, or expire. SECOND FACE, measured 2026-07-27 through the live chat: asked about the hex payback meter — knowledge the library tree genuinely lacks (it lives in the founding tree) — the loop backfilled three path-shaped mints and RESOLVED at 0.8295 on them: home-field advantage does not just outrank real nodes, it can MANUFACTURE resolution where the graph held nothing, and the mints' content was wrong about the actual idea. Traceable throughout, so the verdict is honest about its sources — but a consumer reading only the verdict line would call that answered. The tenure loop now has two whys and a third customer: cross-TREE resolution (the founding tree could have answered) is a filed question.

falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a deposit without a traceable source LANDS (trees tooth 1 — the founding defect in permanent residence); (2) an edge table appears (the derived-edges claim gone hollow); (3) a dimension mismatch is ANSWERED instead of refused; (4) a non-librarian write lands (Law 6 physics failed through the stack); (5) a duplicate deposit grows the table; (6) a deposit crossing leaves no breadcrumb; (7) trees.py or loop.py grows an import outside its allowlist (a second door); (8) the loop returns a generate answer instead of a walk (the host in the answer path — loop tooth: the answer comes from structure); (9) two backfill prompts for the same question against a CHANGED graph canonicalize to the same cache key (the livelock reopened — loop's livelock tooth pins canonicalize inequality); (10) a no-progress round spins instead of terminating loudly; (11) a shelved address changes meaning (different bytes land at a standing address, or a rotted copy quietly grounds a citation — library teeth: frozen means frozen, rot is loud); (12) a learned node's citation cannot be traced back to shelf + passage + frozen digest; (13) a summary citation names a node the region never held, or prose without a single anchor passes as a summary (minted attribution wearing a bibliography — summarize teeth); (14) a summary does NOT land back in the graph, or the transducer renders its own prior output (the view detached, or a photocopy of a photocopy); (15) a chat turn spends inference on ROUTING (a guessed intent where the stated prefix is the physics), or a chat reply carries the generate text instead of the walk (a chatbot wearing a librarian's charter — chat teeth pin both); (16) a refused turn kills the session or is silently swallowed (a refusal is a reply, and its breadcrumb stands). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNALS: every node still 'hypothesis' weeks into live use (the tenure loop never landed); answers coming from inference when the graph already holds the structure (the core loop bypassed — the device demoted to a vector cache); UNRESOLVED verdicts booked anywhere as savings.

Warp speed.') closed the chain the same day: the conversation live over the library tree — a question about the audit agent RESOLVED by walk alone (0.6772, zero backfills, stone 4's landed summary riding the walk as structure); the summarize: affordance rendered cited prose through the browser door (8 of 34 nodes, two shelved passages and four backfill mints, each legible by source); and a question the tree could not ground (the hex payback meter) backfilled three mints and 'resolved' on them — edge (l)'s second face, measured, recorded. 2026-07-28, the carrier corrected on Akien's word (CC--): the first cast wired a bespoke /chat route + injected source — a parallel door; re-cast same-arc to the ratified shape (ONE web server; the chat window a pane the base shim class understands; LibrarianShim starts the device if it is not running; POST travels as mail through deliver; daemon.py → listener.py, NO DAEMONS stated as law). The face is whole: learning always, summarizing when asked, every answer from structure.
